# Ungrabbable

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

Nothing grabs or picks up this entity.

## Notes

Read by Grab and Hold; Mountables puts it on the animals' collider entities.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: Grab, Hold. Written by: Mountables. Created by: Mountables. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Grab](../systems/Grab.md) | system | Host | **read** | grab | such entities are skipped |
| [Hold](../systems/Hold.md) | system | Host | **read** | pick | not picked up |
| [Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | tick | on the collider entity |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
